name: rift

scripts.test:runner: node --test tools/probe-verdict.test.mjs tools/native-entry-manifest.test.mjs tools/native-build-runner.test.mjs tools/legacy-suite.test.mjs tools/scriptc-path.test.mjs
scripts.test:guest:node: npm run build:node && node tools/run-guests.mjs node
scripts.test:guest:native: npm run build:native && node tools/run-guests.mjs native
scripts.test: npm run test:runner && npm run test:guest:node
scripts.format: oxfmt src test probes tools .oxlintrc.json .oxlint-typed.json .oxfmtrc.json .readability-baseline.json package.json tsconfig.json
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check src test probes tools .oxlintrc.json .oxlint-typed.json .oxfmtrc.json .readability-baseline.json package.json tsconfig.json
scripts.lint: npm run lint:basic && npm run lint:typed && npm run lint:policy && npm run lint:structure
scripts.lint:basic: oxlint src test probes tools --report-unused-disable-directives-severity error --deny-warnings

description: A JavaScript interpreter written in TypeScript and compiled with scriptc
